intro: The Paraguay River divides the country into the green east and the dry Chaco in the west.

chapters.title: East and west
text: Most people live in the east, with forests and farmland. The Gran Chaco in the west covers over half the land but has few people.
The Itaipú Dam on the Paraná River, shared with Brazil, is one of the largest hydroelectric plants in the world.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Paraguay's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
